name: TryFrom<pb::Command> for Command<Unverified> / From<&Command<S>> for pb::Command

test_list.description: One sample of each of the 10 sdk CommandBody variants survives sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk unchanged; an exhaustive match in the test fails to compile when the sdk adds a variant.

A Command<Verified> encodes to the same bytes as the matching unverified command and decodes back as Command<Unverified>: approval never crosses the wire. This unchanged test lives in polaris-kernel-verifier/tests/verified_command_wire.rs so witness construction stays in the allowed boundary.
A command without id, frame, body or body kind gives MissingField naming the field.
SpawnSubagent with role/effort 0 (unspecified) or an unknown number gives UnknownVariant.
A default pb::Command and a default pb::CommandBody return Err.
For arbitrary commands (ids, token bytes, every body variant): sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk is the identity.
Arbitrary bytes decoded as pb::Command and converted give Ok or Err, never a panic.

dependencies: polaris_sdk::contracts::{Command, CommandBody, Unverified, Verified, ApprovalWitness, TokenBytes}

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: A decoded protobuf command, possibly hostile or incomplete.

output_type: Result<Command<Unverified>, ProtoError> (pb -> sdk) or pb::Command (sdk -> pb, infallible)
output_description: An unverified sdk command; verification is a job of the kernel and cannot be forged by the wire.
